'''Oversized''' is a weapon [[Experimental Effects|Experimental Effect]] that uses enlarged components and reinforced munition housings to increase damage. An [[Engineers|Engineer]] installs it after a compatible weapon has received a normal [[Engineering Blueprints|Engineering Blueprint]].

== Effects ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Attribute
! Modifier
|-
| Damage
| +3%
|-
| Power draw
| +5%
|}

The damage bonus increases each damaging shot without changing the weapon's firing cadence. It therefore raises theoretical damage per second by the same proportion while the weapon continues to fire.

The penalty increases the weapon's demand on the ship's [[Power Plant]]. It does not directly alter distributor draw, thermal load, rate of fire, magazine size, reserve ammunition, reload speed, projectile speed, range, or armour piercing.

== Compatibility ==

Current Engineering references list Oversized for:<ref name="inara">[https://inara.cz/elite/experimentaleffects/ INARA: Engineering — Experimental effects], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

* [[Beam Laser|Beam]], [[Burst Laser|Burst]], and [[Pulse Laser|Pulse Lasers]];
* [[Multi-Cannon|Multi-cannons]];
* [[Plasma Accelerator|Plasma Accelerators]];
* [[Fragment Cannon|Fragment Cannons]];
* [[Cannon|Cannons]];
* [[Railgun|Railguns]];
* [[Mine Launcher|Mine Launchers]];
* [[Torpedo Pylon|Torpedo Pylons]];
* seeker and dumbfire [[Missile Rack|Missile Racks]].

Experimental weapons and mining tools do not accept Oversized.<ref name="wiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Oversized Elite Dangerous Wiki: Oversized], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref> Specialised weapon variants should be checked in the Engineer interface before gathering materials.

== Materials ==

Applying Oversized consumes:

* 5 Mechanical Scrap;
* 3 Mechanical Components;
* 1 Ruthenium.<ref name="wiki" />

Experimental Effects are installed once rather than progressed through Grades 1–5. The Engineer must support the receiving weapon family and be visited in person; [[Remote Engineering]] cannot add or replace an Experimental Effect.

== Selection guidance ==

Oversized is the straightforward damage choice when no specialised effect is more important and the ship has enough deployed power. Its fixed 3% bonus works without a target condition, ammunition type, heat threshold, or timing window.

Check the complete build before applying it:

* a power-limited ship may benefit more from [[Flow Control]] or a Power Plant change;
* [[Multi-servos]] produces a similar theoretical damage-per-second increase through firing rate, but consumes ammunition faster;
* status effects such as [[Emissive Munitions]] can contribute more to a coordinated or utility-focused loadout;
* weapons constrained by distributor energy, heat, reloads, or ammunition may not sustain their theoretical output.

Because only one Experimental Effect can be fitted at a time, choose Oversized for its measured contribution to the intended build rather than for the damage number in isolation.
